channel.title: News Bot — TechCrunch AI (Tech & AI)
channel.description: RSS-Feed für die Quelle 'TechCrunch AI' (Kategorie: Tech & AI).

item.title: AI inference startup Fal doubles its valuation to $16B as demand surges
item.description: The five-year-old startup raised a $1.3 billion round led by Bessemer.

item.title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
item.description: The first experimental feature under the tab will allow users to get recommendations based on what they're currently in the mood for.

item.title: Anthropic is still grappling with the economics of compute
item.description: At a moment when Anthropic's compute margins should be getting better, they’re getting worse.

item.title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
item.description: Schools choosing to restrict AI altogether will no longer be able to access Google Search, as AI features are now integrated into the search engine.

item.title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
item.description: Apple's new App Store rules will require 18+ ratings for dating apps and AI companions that offer sexual or romantic content.

item.title: The TechCrunch Founder Summit agenda is only half the reason to be in Boston on Nov. 4
item.description: On Nov. 4, TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 brings founders and VCs to Boston's SoWa Power Station for practical insights and connections. Register before prices increase at the door.

item.title: Tomorrow: TechCrunch Founder Summit takes over Boston and when pass rates increase
item.description: Secure your TechCrunch Founder Summit pass savings before prices increase tomorrow at 9 a.m. ET. Save up to $100 on your pass, and get a second for free.

item.title: Apple Watch’s AI features for rewinding and recapping conversations begin beta testing
item.description: Now in beta: Apple's new Audio Intelligence features can help you remember what someone said or take notes on conversations.

item.title: Google takes Dreambeans to India in bid to bring AI-generated personal stories to the masses
item.description: Google's Dreambeans, its latest AI experiment, now supports 13 Indian languages.

item.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
item.description: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.

item.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
item.description: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.

item.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
item.description: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

item.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
item.description: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
